notes.title: New DLC - Dollars & Disasters - Out Now!
notes.content:
Rebel Inc.'s explosive new expansion! Survive an erupting volcano in Devil's Peak, burn through money with The Billionaire, enhance your tactics with new Special Advisors and explore exciting new Official Scenarios.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747950/Rebel_Inc_Escalation__Dollars__Disasters/

[h2]New Region! - Devil's Peak[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/2be954d3927ac657695d5d42180985d18a7aa958.png[/img]
Devil's Peak, a giant volcano, is erupting and the region is counting on you to save as many people as possible! Defeat an insurgency with lava hot on your heels.
You'll be fighting to stabilise Devil's Peak but zones are under constant threat from devastating destructive forces, at any moment they could explode! Manage evacuations, travel restrictions, scientific expeditions and more in this explosive new region.

Read the Travel Alert [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1088790/announcements/detail/3412066846520477544]here.[/url]

[h2]New Governor! - The Billionaire[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/027c19c431d88d72c7904a59cced9274fe58058c.png[/img]
After bragging he could sort this situation out himself, he's putting his money where his mouth is. The Billionaire is ready to bring peace to every region! Bribe insurgents, invest funds, bring in your own charity and throw money at every problem that appears.

Read the tell-all interview with the Billionaire [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1088790/announcements/detail/3484125695440727973]here[/url].

[h2]Special Advisors[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/b35b741bfc6c2b4807c2f6bba53ca057e575f85e.png[/img]
Hire powerful new advisors for your operation, they'll provide incredible benefits but demand a high salary! From ministers, to engineers and even drone controlling robots, with 18 new advisors you'll have more tactical options than ever.

Read about the hiring options [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1088790/announcements/detail/3484125695441319151]here[/url].

[h2]Scenarios[/h2]

Things are heating up in the world of the Official Scenarios too with vicious droughts, magical lamps and deadly outbreaks, can you prevail in these disastrous times?

[h2]The Airlift[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/c1725fc07b9209402c535f48bf2dfc77e78d98e8.png[/img]
Insurgents have cut off access to Mountain Pass! With no way to break through, aircraft around the world have been mobilised to fly in everything the Operation needs.

Await Airdrops, choose supplies carefully and defeat the blockade.

[h2]Orbital Uplink[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/7200095cbffa7dbb457a024a214f01bf8317bba2.png[/img]
The Satellite Commander, a woman of the future, dislikes traditional intelligence gathering, preferring to use a powerful (and expensive) network of spy satellites that provide permanent intel on scanned zones.

Gather intel zone-by-zone and upgrade the satellites to get the ultimate view of a region.

[h2]The Great Droughts[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/c0a72967e498c70cb9f5354f084c61035d522016.png[/img]
Extreme weather is causing the rivers to regularly dry up in Pistachio Forest. 

During droughts, dry river beds can be crossed by Insurgents and Operation forces without restriction. The heat is on...

[h2]The Genie's Curse[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/cc12717a33484887ad974744651ebdc7f52dbc71.png[/img]
Some say the desert harbours ancient and powerful relics, granting wishes at a terrible cost... Hunt for the magic lamps before they can be used by the Insurgency.

Can you become all-powerful? Or will you be cursed for eternity?

[h2]Before the Storm[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/0ec57ec2091414506a979e3e2c7e6b67b7cc13df.png[/img]
Scientists are concerned about reports of seismic activity on a fault line which leads to a volcano. Geological survey teams have been dispatched to ascertain what's happening.

Gather geological data with science teams while fending off the Insurgents to discover what's coming...

Get it now!

notes.title: Special Advisor Programme Candidates
notes.content:
[b]F.A.O. OPERATION DIRECTOR. PRIORITY ALPHA [/b]
[i]As discussed, here are a few of the many new candidates who will be joining the Operation shortly. Please remember each of the 'Special Advisors' will require remuneration ahead of field deployment. 

Kind Regards, 
HR.[/i] 

[h2]War Hero[/h2]
[i]"Coalition Soldiers gain additional deployment time after winning battles"[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/a16e6da7771f666f7a1ffceb94692f2a67057967.png[/img]
[h3]Experience & Expertise[/h3]
[list]
[*] 30 years of military service
[*] Inspiration to the troops
[/list][h3]Biography[/h3]
There's nobody quite like the War Hero, 15 medals, a knighthood, veteran of five wars and twenty-two conflict zones.

Now retired from active duty, he spends his time inspiring Coalition Soldiers with his tales of heroism. He's been in more difficult situations than anyone, and he's always survived.

The very presence of the War Hero ensures that Coalition Soldiers will gladly extend their tours, only too happy to continue to serve.


[h2]Remote Specialist[/h2]
[i]"Start with a remote specialist attachment"[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/09faa73c85650f305db181c5d14b2fac4b9a7a5b.png[/img]
[h3]Experience & Expertise:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Remote Communities
[*] Mountain Guide
[/list][h3]Biography[/h3]
Living in the remote mountains of Pistachio Forest, the Remote Specialist knows a thing or two about difficult terrain and isolated communities.

Making his living guiding foreign companies and tourists through the mountains and thick forests, he's now available to join military units and provide essential combat intel to boost Soldiers' effectiveness in remote zones.


[h2]Local Liaison[/h2]
[i]"Concerns grow at a reduced rate."[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/542920cabf43ada9dd2dd9f9c1088b2cdc11ceaa.png[/img]
[h3]Experience and Expertise:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Conflict Resolution
[*] Community Focus
[/list][h3]Biography[/h3]
The Local Liaison is a true pillar of the community. Utterly trustworthy, he cuts through jargon and misinformation.

His goal is to minimise misunderstandings between communities and the Operation. He brings the news of the Operation's work and it will appease people… for a while.


[h2]Friendly Robot[/h2]
[i]"Manually control drones."[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/09174552bc32218c819e8824afbd445d5ff12c1e.png[/img]
[h3]Experience and Expertise:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Surveillance Drone Interfacing
[*] Customer Service
[/list][h3]Biography[/h3]
Designed by Decker Hamilton to be the ultimate Mall greeter, this $4 Billion Dollar prototype was a failure until the war of 2002 when it was accidentally discovered it could easily interface with drone technology to directly control their movements.
Now installed in Drone Command, the robot relays instructions to drones around the country, always responding with a smile and a [i]"Is there anything else I can help you with today?"[/i].


[h2]Intelligence Officer[/h2]
[i]"Soldiers scout intel in neighbouring zones."[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/9a97b0460517d888e7886be904b6c16b186a2a1b.png[/img]
[h3]Experience and Expertise:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Intelligence Gathering
[*] 25 years as █████████ at ███
[*] Section Chief of ████ involved in ██████████████████ - █████████ incident
[/list][h3]Biography[/h3]
█████████ 

As an international operative, the Intelligence Officer has seen █████ and knows how to find out what █████████ hasn't.

Coordinating with █████████ on the ground, █████████ will improve their intel gathering abilities on neighbouring zones.


[h2]Quartermaster[/h2]
[i]"Start with an extra Garrison."[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/16212c99704eb56414bb108dba5ee4bb1c998b1f.png[/img]
[h3]Experience and Expertise[/h3]
[list]
[*] Military defence
[*] Requisition
[/list][h3]Biography[/h3]
Keeping everything shipshape and Bristol fashion, the Quartermaster's goal is order and preparedness.

Recruiting them will ensure an organised forward base at the start of your Operation, providing a strong foothold in the region.

Vast riches are buried deep below the dunes. Control the oil. Control the Region.

Sand & Secrets is our first DLC, and is free for the first month of launch so pick it up now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2114460/Rebel_Inc_Escalation__Sand__Secrets/

[previewyoutube=got1-cyJt_g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New Lands Await[/h3]
A whole new region to stabilise, full of vast sand dunes and untapped potential… It must be kept from the Insurgents at any cost.

[h3]Oil is Money, Money is Power[/h3]
Securing the Oil Fields is your top priority, they will provide you with additional funds.

You're not the only one looking to secure the oil, the Insurgency will focus on capturing the fields with alarming aggression.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/bf17730f73e032557b2aa492974e84467f18f544.png[/img]

notes.title: The Spring Cleaning Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/a2118093e14d8a00569c710d3e6481cf8695d866.png[/img]
Previous updates have seen us release lots of new content for Rebel Inc. However in this update, we wanted to take a moment to tackle some improvements we’ve been wanting to get to for a while. 

So here it is, The Spring Cleaning Update! With a huge number of bugs fixed, balance tweaks and a whole bunch of feature improvements.

[h3]Changelog Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] Balance changes Concerns, Warlord, General, Opium Trail, Insurgents, Campaign mode and more!
[*] Quality of Life improvements including: Difficulty shields for Scenarios, new VS bonuses, new operation names, improved garrison targetting and more!
[*] Heaps of bugs fixed in menus, multiplayer, civilian gameplay, combat gameplay and visuals!
[/list]

We've got more cool updates coming soon! Such as the new region: Golden Sands, a mysterious governor and more! Keep an eye on our social feeds and Discord for the latest news!

Big thanks to these community members in particular who were a huge help in reporting bugs and providing feedback:
[i]transportowiec96, Arsalan, killergotrekt, c0rupt1ble, Undefind, Tech. TTGames and Cyndicate[/i]

Some of the operation names were chosen by the community thanks to:
[i]Liquidator Conduct.#3287, Xupypr [KZ], Gotchfutchian, Alternatum, Reonardo#8739, Freefall, Apex Prime, عبدالرحمن#0432, Tenko#5749, Elioc997472#9457, Vex, Lightning#0304, Mizuki142, MMG_Youtube#4370, Quietbook and SoraTheSkrub [/i]

[h1]Full Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[h3]Game[/h3]
[list]
[*] Zones are less likely to be picked for zone actions if Insurgents are adjacent, the impact of this has now been lessened for the HQ zone
[*] Charity decision now always appears between 30-60 turns after the initiative has been purchased
[*] Rebalanced VS Multiplayer mode Region income bonuses (Steam only)
[*] In the Peace Deal decision, the chance for Support Level to catastrophically fall now only appears after the third time the "Threaten" option is selected, or if Support Level is really low
[/list]

[h3]Initiatives[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the Inflation caused when purchasing Jobs Initiatives
[*] Reduced the cost of Electricity Initiatives
[*] Increased the boost Electricity Initiatives give to future zone action rollout speed
[/list]

[h3]Concerns[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Concerns should now appear less frequently, rewarding players that are able to satisfy them early
[*] Decreased the average number of Initiatives required to satisfy a local Concern
[*] Concerns for Security, Road, Telecom, Electricity and Jobs will now grow slower than Concerns for other Initiatives
[*] If there are no stable Zones, Initiative rollouts will now heavily prioritize building in your most stable Zone
[*] Funding an initiative now slows down all corresponding Concerns
[*] Concerns now have a slightly higher chance to appear
[*] Further reduced the growth rate of Security, Electric, and Telecom Concerns
[/list]

[h3]Rollout[/h3]
[list]
[*] Further improved build rollouts to more accurately select high priority initiatives
[/list]

[h3]General (Governor)[/h3]
[list]
[*] The General now starts with 3 Garrisons instead of 1
[*] Artillery Upgrades and Underbarrel Attachments now cost less and have a slightly stronger effect
[*] Martial Law now sets your reputation to 16 instead of 8
[/list]

[h3]Tank Commander[/h3]
[list]
[*] The cost of Tank Commander's Initiatives has been reduced slightly for Brutal and Mega Brutal
[/list]

[h3]Warlord[/h3]
[list]
[*] Warlord has a longer delay before losing reputation to lack of Stability
[*] Increased the strength of the Warlord's National Soldiers
[*] Decreased the rate at which the Warlords National Soldiers become restless
[/list]

[h3]Advisors[/h3]
[list]
[*]Wealthy Exile has a much stronger effect
[/list]

[h3]Opium Trail[/h3]
[list]
[*] Significantly increased the time required before Poppy Fields fields in Remote zones give an increase to Insurgent Capability
[*] Significantly slowed the rate of Reputation loss from Poppy Fields in Remote zones
[/list]

[h3]Campaign Tactics and Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sleeper cells should now always trigger if Insurgents control 3 or fewer zones, with the spawn probability trailing off as before when controlling more zones
[*] Reduced the number of Zones Insurgents flee to when using the “Split and Run” tactic
[*] Targeted Air Support: Reduced to 1 star

[*] Added a popup to confirm closing the game

[/list]

[h3]Civilian Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where you couldn't resolve service protests over lack of Jobs or Services
[*] Fixed a bug where all Concerns would only require one Initiative to solve

[*] Fixed the "Pause" text not showing at the start of the game
[*] Fixed an issue where new buildings would not be visible
[/list]

[*] Fixed issue where Insurgents would gain control of a Zone while losing in combat

[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Azure Dam decision option "Harvest Fish" both cost and gave Funds
[*] Fixed a bug where the "months until next convoy" message could appear as a negative value
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where a field in Opium Trail was not desaturating when the containing Zone had no Intel
[*] Fixed issue in Opium Trail where Zones with full Intel would be delayed in updating
[*] Tourist Advisor now correctly gives Intel on two Zones in Mega Brutal on Opium Trail
[*] Fixed an issue where Poppy Fields were invisible if next a Garrison
[/list]

[h3]Campaign / Tactics / Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the popup announcing another region stabilising in Campaign mode was not translating
[*] Sniper Support no longer prevents Morale Boost from working

[*] Scenarios

[*] Soldiers continue to be stuck in an endless fight even when Insurgents have been killed or "Ghost Insurgents" as it's become known. We have been unable to find reliable steps to reproduce this issue, and we are also keen to know if the issue still persists after the additional fixes included in this update
[*] When playing Co-Op multiplayer, the game can break on the Governor/Region select screens
[*] Some decisions are not reappearing when saving and loading the game while they are on the map
[*] Very rarely, airstrikes sometimes don't work, especially in multiplayer VS

Developer Notes
[list]

notes.title: Official Scenarios - Turrets, Convoys and Fortresses
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/7ac523ee62c864513b06907c40ab2386e8d56ed0.png[/img]
Face your greatest challenge yet in a new collection of Rebel Inc. Official Scenarios, featuring murderous turrets, mountain fortresses and the ultra brutal insurgency!

[h2]Defense Grid[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/cebf0693b0459cdac1757f61d15fb1fd03e261cb.jpg[/img]
The Insurgents are using advanced cell tactics and splintering whenever defeated in combat.

The use of AI Sentry Turrets has been authorised. Equipped with threat sensors, they can pin Insurgents down and inflict heavy casualties over time.

Use high-tech automated defences to fight a tenacious Insurgency.



[h2]Ultra Mega Insurgency[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/ffccd46c4468ae1e7e7b93f31372eeb30bb7ff5b.jpg[/img]
The Insurgency is equipped with every Insurgent Tactic! The odds are against you and extreme strategic abilities will be needed to win.

WARNING - this is the most challenging Rebel Inc. scenario ever! The developers can just about manage to beat it on casual difficulty…


[h2]Hell's Highway[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/9bba2125d129542c1308899a6e3cb66adcec3fcd.jpg[/img]
Vital convoys are headed towards the soon-to-be-completed Azure Dam carrying supplies and machinery. But first, they have to navigate Hell's Highway and the Insurgents know they are coming...

Defend convoys from those damned(!) Insurgent attacks as they travel through the region.

[h2]Immortal Fortress[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/a07d1e9a4483b11ddd89c841c3b0d4f0e87bb44d.jpg[/img]
Insurgents have established a base of operations in an ancient mountain fortress. The structure offers a formidable defence against military intervention; the Insurgents will not let it fall easily.

Break through the Insurgent fortifications and gain control of the fortress to secure the Region.

[h2]Desolate Fields[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/5f9e15602f95c04b64fa81d2fa040882f7a014ad.jpg[/img]
After decades of civil war, the once tranquil Saffron Plains have fallen to the Insurgency. The thriving saffron trade has died out, and the population has turned to your Operation to save the Region from the brink of collapse.

A fast and effective response will be required to save this Region before it's too late.

That's it for this year! We'll be developing more scenarios in the future, what would you like to see? Fill out [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSecOL5aOazPY0tACwIHkoZtTDjH2fq7dtqz6jHsxStQ0e0Pcw/viewform]this form[/url], post in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1088790/discussions/0/1631916406864327892/]Steam Forums[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/ndemic]join our Discord[/url] and tell us what you want to see! 

Be sure to check out the custom scenarios made by the community in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=1088790&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems&actualsort=trend&p=1&days=-1]Steam Workshop[/url]! Or even create your own in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1088790/announcements/detail/2944779688080138439]Scenario Creator[/url].



The Ndemic Creations team

[*] Added 5 new Official Scenarios
[*] Fixed issue in Omnigovernor and Private Contractor where region initiative would not appear
[*] Insurgent in a Tank scenario: The tank will no longer panic when repeatedly attacked in the same zone. Instead it will carefully consider its strategy and execute its plan accordingly ([url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kQ5IMgEzIiU]take that Pravus[/url])
[/list]

notes.title: Official Scenarios - Embassies, Helicopters and Tunnels
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/a3b23bfe7804e28ede37418f226f5c3f7c6cdcd5.png[/img]

Take on a new set of deliciously dangerous Rebel Inc. Official Scenarios, featuring hopelessly besieged embassies, vicious helicopter gunships and expansive tunnel networks! 

[h2]Flying Fury[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/e8561cd4d6d95bbc2bafa13d97a9fb38d37ab6cf.jpg[/img]
Bring death from above with the advanced Helicopter Gunship. Seek and destroy stolen weapons caches, training grounds and camps to force the Insurgents into submission.

Deploy a powerful helicopter to provide mobile offensive and defensive capabilities during this engagement.

Move fast; hit hard.


[h2]Corporate Development[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/6163a57177f86df3d3d8651185c269c3f6d819df.jpg[/img]
A mega-corporation has secured all construction contracts in the region. The Board of Directors refuses to allow the unsupervised roll out of civilian initiatives so multiple Experts must be deployed to roll out Initiatives directly.

Balance Experts, Hostility and Corruption to stabilise the Region zone by zone.


[h2]Embassy Evacuation[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/66baf41253c1be5e0fa473a98ec4d4eff896629b.jpg[/img]
Insurgents are launching a huge attack to kidnap negotiators and disrupt the fragile peace process.
Strategically evacuate your embassies before the insurgents reach them and hold out against relentless assault waves until the peace deal can be signed.

[h2]Dark Tunnels[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/bef4eab05eff500b14ed4d6cf2366b1b515d6925.jpg[/img]
A large and well-established network of interconnected Tunnels has been identified in this Region, allowing the Insurgency to attack or flee through Zones across the map. Bunker Buster missiles have been authorised to assist in stabilising the Region.

Careful strategic management of military resources will be required to suppress the insurgency here.


We hope you enjoy them! 

However, prepare yourself, as more Rebel Inc. Official Scenarios will be dropping soon and they’re the most brutal yet...

notes.title: Official Scenarios - Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/08129b40b95e3fec5d63664f245bc445ea1ec320.png[/img]
Jump into the Rebel Inc. multiverse with a series of exciting new Official Scenarios! Tackle devious new challenges, discover new ways to play and explore bizarre worlds.


[h2]Southern Tropics[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/539958438f5723a75ff80612e8310aa9d6e202ee.jpg[/img]
The Insurgents aren't the only threat in this hot, humid land. Cases of the Southern Fever have been detected across the Region, leaving Soldiers vulnerable to infection.

There's no cure but the new Medic governor can treat soldiers to get them back to strength and stop them spreading the infection further.


[h2]Insurgents On A Tank![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/ce2d0bd4cb6f6236692e51429d30f658c863bc6a.jpg[/img]
The last insurgents in the Region have stolen a tank and are trying to attack your HQ! The tank can't be killed but your soldiers can make it flee in panic.

Buy your negotiators enough time as they try to persuade the insurgents to come out of the tank!


[h2]Evolving Insurgency[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/a72bc64ef852cab854360563e28ab05977ac8193.jpg[/img]
The Insurgency is rapidly developing new Tactics. Left to their own devices, they will soon overwhelm any efforts to stabilise the Region. Halt the increasingly dangerous Insurgency and defeat them!

[h2]Omnigovernor[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/7bc8e445ca3a084bafbd511894a94df9605c0191.jpg[/img]

Flourish and fail with the benefits and the drawbacks of every governor at once.

We hope you enjoy them!

Can't wait until then? Check out the custom scenarios made by the community in the Steam Workshop! Or even create your own in the Scenario Creator.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/7b50caae7a894aad012bbcb6c1f732f1ed74e4a3.png[/img]

After over 4 years of development and two years in Early Access, we’re finally here - Rebel Inc: Escalation 1.0 is out! Thank you so much to the Rebel Inc: Escalation community for helping along the way by sharing feedback and suggestions on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1088790/discussions/]steam forums[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/ndemic]Discord[/url]. Truly, we could not have done this without you!

To celebrate leaving Early Access and all we’ve added over the last couple of years, check out our shiny new trailer!

[previewyoutube=bSEi4jocmNk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Looking Back[/h1]
The last two years in Early Access have been quite a ride! In that time, we’ve added a steady stream of massive free updates to the game including…

[h2]Campaign Mode[/h2]
This enormous addition completely changed the Rebel Inc: Escalation experience, allowing the community to play a sequence of connected games over several Regions. It also introduced a huge number of Map Features, Player and Insurgent Perks, bringing more variation to the game. 

[h2]New Maps[/h2]
Three new regions were added, accompanied by new mechanics to mix up gameplay. The Infamous Black Caves region introduced Caves to the game, whilst the Azure Dam tasked players with defending a convoy from an insurgent threat. Finally Opium Trail introduced opium farms and the Initiatives to combat them. 

[h2]Challenge Mode[/h2]
Weekly Challenges were added to the game, featuring preset combinations of Region, Governor, Advisors, Map Features, Player and Insurgent Tactics as well as starting control. Two new Challenges are released every Wednesday in both standard and Brutal difficulties. Challenges are the same for the whole community, allowing players to compete for the number 1 spot!

[h2]Vs Multiplayer - Control the Insurgents[/h2]
Vs Multiplayer lets players take control of the Insurgency in their opponent’s Region to try and topple their government, while still trying to stabilise their own! A whole suite of new Initiatives and Active abilities were introduced such as Ambushes and Garrison Sabotage. Vs Mode also features dynamically scaling difficulty, ensuring that players of different skill levels can have a good, challenging game.

[h2]Co-Op Multiplayer[/h2]
Co-Op Multiplayer allowed two players to work together to simultaneously stabilise two separate Regions. Players share Reputation and need to work together to succeed - sending each other resources and soldiers to achieve their goals. Players are also able to purchase a series of specially designed new Initiatives as well as embark on a Co-Op Campaign with their partner. 

[h2]New Governors[/h2]
Two new governors were added, each radically shaking up gameplay. The Development Director focusses on prioritising zones for development, while fan favourite, the Tank Commander focussed on crushing their opponents with big heavy tanks!

[h2]Scenario Creator[/h2]
The much requested Scenario Creator gave the community a voice, letting players dive into the nuts and bolts of the game to build their own Scenarios. Along with this came a group of new structures like Oil Derricks, Tunnels and Rogue Outposts, allowing hugely varied gameplay opportunities.

[h2]Custom Scenarios [/h2]
Along with the Scenario Creator, this update really gave the community the chance to play Rebel Inc: Escalation in fresh new ways - new scenarios are going up to the Steam Workshop every day! 

[h2]Speed Run[/h2]
Speedrunners in our community rejoiced as they were finally able to prove who was quickest on each Region, once and for all.

[h2]Stats & Progress[/h2]
This special treat for the statheads in our community (you know who you are!) let players dive into their history to shine a light on how they play.

[h2]And the Rest...[/h2]
Of course along with our major updates, we were always working to improve the game in myriad other ways including adding an entirely new difficulty, updating artwork, localisation improvements, balance tweaks, quality of life enhancements and hundreds (and hundreds) of bug fixes. 

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
This isn't the end of the road for Rebel Inc: Escalation! We’ll be continuing to update the game in the future. Got an idea for what you’d like to see? Let us know in our [url=https://discord.gg/ndemic]Discord[/url] or on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1088790/discussions/]Steam forums[/url].

We’re thrilled to be moving on to the next chapter for Rebel Inc. Thank you so much to each and everyone one of you for supporting us on the way.

Ndemic Creations Team.

notes.title: The Anniversary Update - 0.7.5.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/1a64b4fd90c9f96aaafd637d931b96b1eca8cab3.png[/img]
It’s been an incredible first year for Rebel Inc: Escalation. Watching the community’s positive response to the various maps, governors and campaign updates has been absolutely fantastic. Seeing the game grow and reach new audiences has been very special. 
 
To celebrate our one year anniversary on Steam, we’re releasing an update today with lots of new player and insurgent tactics as well as a series of new map features adding further variety to your campaigns! On top of this, there’s some tweaks and improvements to gameplay and UI. 


[h2]Player Tactics[/h2]
Several exciting new tactics are now available to the operation including...

[h3]On The Job Training[/h3]
When Coalition soldiers withdraw, they’ll leave a national unit in their place.  
 
[h3]Overwatch[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/46178008084dd67cdfb8f50f9bb9d98a2dc3a676.png[/img]
If insurgents are adjacent to a garrison, they will always attack it. As such, insurgents become more predictable and easier to defend against. Combine with Trip Wires for an explosive surprise!  

[h2]Insurgent Tactics[/h2]
It’s not just your operation that’s got a range of new tactics. There’s a series of updates for the Insurgents too, including...

[h3]Fanatical Fighters[/h3]
A new type of fighter has entered the battlefield with significantly increased strength. However, their fanatical nature means that they will never retreat! 

[h3]Social Distancing[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/35eeda42a3d0f8beb3dc3a74c75d474af7951c5a.png[/img]
The insurgents have learned some new tricks! Now when hit by airstrikes they’ll scatter and run to neighbouring regions.  

[h2]Map Features[/h2]
On top of the tactics there’s a series of new map features to mix up play, including...

[h3]Oil Survey[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/0161111718a42f878f1b90347efc820e04684f92.png[/img]
The soldiers are here to stay! Especially when there’s all this oil laying around unguarded... This feature allows your troops to remain indefinitely in a region.

[h3]Soviet Bunkers[/h3]
Insurgents have discovered a network of abandoned Soviet bunkers and dug in. They are much more resilient than before, needing multiple airstrikes to be destroyed.

[h3]Amphibious Support[/h3]
New equipment now lets your soldiers support their comrades across rivers.  
 
All this and much more is available now in the Anniversary Update! (see the full change log below)
 
[h2]Future Updates[/h2]
Thank you for your continued support throughout our first year on Steam. With the big campaign update released - we are now hard at work designing multiplayer and custom scenarios for Rebel Inc: Escalation. These are very big, complex updates so we don’t have a release date yet but will share more information as soon as we can.
 
The Ndemic Team
 
[h3]Full Changelog[/h3]
[h3]11 new Player Tactics:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Propaganda Team - Gain reputation when insurgent camps are destroyed 
[*] Fiscal Windfall - Gain funds when urban zones stabilise for the first time
[*] Overwatch - If insurgents are adjacent to a garrison, they can only attack the garrison
[*] Advanced Warfare - Significantly increase soldier combat strength
[*] Private Military Contractors - Coalition unit deployment time is extended with funds instead of reputation
[*] Personal Teleporters - Soldiers instantly travel across regions
[*] On The Job Training - Coalition soldiers leave a national unit when they are withdrawn
[*] Development Roadmap - No concerns
[*] Government Takeover - Insurgent camps become garrisons when destroyed
[*] Coordinated Fireteams - Soldiers can support while fighting
[*] Committed Coalition - Coalition soldiers never withdraw
[/list]
 
[h3]3 new Insurgent Tactics:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Violent Ambushes - Deployment of coalition soldiers costs significantly more reputation to extend
[*] Social Distancing - Small groups of insurgents run to neighbouring regions when hit by airstrikes
[*] Fanatical Fighters - Insurgents have significantly increased strength, but cannot flee
[/list]
 
[h3]10 new Map Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unreliable Funding - Income is significantly more inconsistent
[*] Concrete Shortage - Garrison initiatives are unavailable
[*] Budget Deadline - Income stops after 10 years
[*] Catacombs - Caves are located in some urban zones
[*] Amphibious Support - Soldiers can support across rivers
[*] Advance Development - Some civilian initiatives already funded
[*] Scouts - Soldiers scout intel in neighbouring zones
[*] Soviet Bunkers - Insurgent camps take multiple airstrikes before being destroyed
[*] Inaccessible Terrain - Garrisons cannot be built in remote zones
[*] Oil Survey - Coalition soldiers never withdraw
[/list]
 
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some popups so the "confirm" option is now correctly positioned on the left side button
[*] Various minor gameplay tweaks
[*] UI tweaks

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[*] Combat reset bug (we’re working on it). 

[/list]

We're back with another update, new tactics and map features, fixes and improvements. Let's dive in!

[b]New Tactics and Map Features[/b]

In the first of many updates, we're adding more tactics and map features to Campaign. These can now appear in your campaigns:

[b]New Map Features[/b]

notes.title: The Campaign Update
notes.content:
[h2]Campaign Mode[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/9cf0a2851d5b8d965d557890b1b8e5cbe036ba00.png[/img]

The Campaign Update is now live - this huge new game mode completely changes the way you can play the game.

Get ready to conduct large-scale operations across multiple regions to bring peace to an entire country. Develop unique tactics and manage resources in a persistent world with all new map features and overcome radically different strategic challenges.

[h3]Features[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/55d588530b3b8927f5fccb40de3068d2df0f463c.gif[/img]

[b]Embark on a grand campaign:[/b] Deploy your operation across five regions with unique and procedurally generated characteristics. Hyperinflation, a vulnerable foreign embassy, huge numbers of national soldiers or even an urban warzone - the combinations are endless.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/feede5c51d3d13fed9e4b1ce49a82225843275b8.png[/img]

[b]Face an ever adapting Insurgency:[/b] As the campaign goes on, the Insurgents will learn devastating new tactics to challenge you. Sleeper cells, ambushes or even swimming lessons (!) will radically change how they fight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/186a1b55225e04a5d26f6d369000f503d67b0d14.png[/img]

[b]Develop powerful new tactics:[/b] Each region that you stabilise dramatically expands your abilities and resources. Sniper support, advance development experts, indestructible garrisons, or even removing all corruption in the region open up all kinds of strategic opportunities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/53e220b37239689fd3014bf75ade572d2761cf82.png[/img]

[b]Stay alert and change your strategy:[/b] Choose wisely and plan ahead.
New wildcard features mean governors and advisors get exhausted, caves can be found in any region and even Azure Dam without the dam! You'll need to think on your feet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/1d1c8bbf0745f7f7e2d597bdc2e2ab7f78e902ac.png[/img]

[b]Experience a persistent narrative:[/b] Engage with new dynamic events and difficult multi-region decisions which have lasting consequences throughout the campaign. Coups, outbreaks, economic downturn and even popular television shows are disasters waiting to happen in these system driven events.

This is just the beginning of our campaign mode, we have lots of exciting additions coming!

[h3]Change Log highlights[/h3]
[list][*] Added campaign mode and achievements
[*] Fixed a rare issue where rebels were able run through soldier occupied zones
[*] Added autosave feature when quitting a game
[*] Updated Insurgent Activity minimap to better reflect takeover count and impact
[*] Insurgent icon in region screen now fills based on insurgent capability (within 0-100%)
[*] Improved explosion effects
[*] Improved logic for random HQ placement with map feature and Armchair Architect advisor
[*] Improved logic for cave placement
[*] Improved logic for fort placement
[*] Significantly improved insurgent AI when selecting a zone to flee to, increasing the likelihood that they will flee to safety and not into another front-line zone
[*] Increased drones priority when deciding to scan '?' half discovered zones
[/list]
Full change log is available on the forum.

UPDATE: We've released a hotfix patch, including more fixes, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1088790/announcements/detail/2176872191804642363]Change log here[/url]

Note - the campaign mode is only available in English currently. We are working hard on localising it into other languages and will update the game with them soon.
UPDATE: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1088790/announcements/detail/2500009902670920602]Campaign Mode is fully localised[/url]

We are really excited to see you all playing this - let us know how you get on in the forums or on discord :)

The Ndemic Team

notes.title: Update 0.6.2: Mega-Brutal Has Arrived!
notes.content:
As the year draws to a close, and just in time for Christmas, we’ve added some exciting new content to Rebel Inc: Escalation. You’re in for a real challenge with [b]the Mega-Brutal update[/b]!

[h1]New Difficulty: Mega-Brutal[/h1]
For those that think Brutal is Casual, we’ve added an entirely new difficulty to sink your teeth into. Mega-Brutal adds new local concerns around road quality and security, lets insurgents lash out in desperation and adds depth to peace negotiations. It’s important to note that Mega-Brutal will not change the mechanics of the game or affect how you unlock new maps and governors. It only adds an extra challenge for those that want it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/cdabe7db4b858c2037385cbfa61134e3a4bd78d6.gif[/img]

[h1]New Minimap Features[/h1]
If Mega-Brutal isn’t your cup of tea, then don’t worry, we’ve still got a Christmas present for you! For perfecting your strategic play, we’ve introduced an entirely new way to utilize the minimap. Now you can access the following data from the Region screen:
[list][*] Zone Details (zone status and zone names)
[*] Insurgent Activity (security percentage, number of insurgent takeovers and insurgent strength)
[*] Population Percentage (zone population percentages, zone total populations)
[*] Accessibility (zone terrain type, zone road type accessibility percentage, ease of traveling through a zone)
[*] Road Level (road type based shading)
[*] Terrain (terrain type based shading)[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/c7b395ae16811eb4b081155db995dccf6ce26650.png[/img]

[h1]New Language: Turkish[/h1]
For our Turkish speaking players, we are happy to announce that Rebel Inc: Escalation is now localised in your language!

On top of this, we’ve made a few other tweaks and changes, details of which you can find below.

Good luck and happy holidays,

The barrage of quality of life improvements and bug fixes continues. See below for the full change log. Next week - we are aiming to release the new Tank Commander governor - and potentially the full Soundtrack. 

[u]Hotfix 0.5.4 changelog[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where insurgents would flee through soldiers
[*] Improved fort placement AI
[*] Improved quality of drone camera in the zone screen
[*] Improved positions of forts and camps on all maps
[*] No longer able to click through end game screen
[*] Fixed issue where initiative history was not displaying after save and quit 
[*] Fixed Fort and HQ glint animation getting stuck if you zoom right after they spawn.
[*] Scaled HQ model stages for consistency with other models
[*] Improved minimap styling
[*] Soldier Deployment now displays logistics information (useful for Brutal)
[*] Fixed leaderboard next and previous buttons (they didn't previously do anything!)
[*] Fixed zone overview screen cycling issues
[*] Fixed issues with tooltips not disappearing 
[/list]

notes.title: Launch Recap and Hotfix 0.5.3 released
notes.content:
Since launch yesterday, Rebel Inc: Escalation has been doing wonderfully - getting to #5 on the Steam Bestsellers chart, (as well as #1 in the Strategy, Simulation and Indie categories). We also had 5 thousand people simultaneously tune in to watch us play on Steam Broadcast.

Thanks so much to everyone for your support - leaving reviews, tagging the game and telling your friends about the game make a huge difference to how the game does.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/c51ed04e04f0736d9d88e6941b42cb6eb5930ee9.gif[/img]

We are already hard at work prepping the first content update (Tank Commander) but we are also focused on fixing various bugs and quality of life fixes and we just released Hotfix 0.5.3.

[u]Hotfix 0.5.3 changelog
[/u]
[list][*] Forts now have a 'sheen' animation on appearance like the HQ does.
[*] Long text strings fit better in UI
[*] Improved support for ultra wide resolutions (Advisors in particular) 
[*] Bug with scroll view for various UI fixed 
[*] Using hotkeys no longer breaks the tutorial flow
[*] Rare bug with Zone screen and Region screen pie charts fixed
[*] Region screen opens faster
[*] Fixed a bug where moving a soldier was hard if it was close to a decision or fort. Soldier / decision HQ / rebel base / etc clicking order is now correct. 
[*] Rebel base visual logic fix - model and icon show correctly based on intel. Base has a combat icon. 
[*] Distant steppe HQ overview glitching terrain fix 
[*] Improved concrete for HQ drone cam as it upgrades 
[*] Airstrike explosions now correctly target rebel base rather than appearing at edge of zone 
[/list]

More to come! :)

The Ndemic Team

notes.title: Rebel Inc: Escalation - release date announced
notes.content:
Good news everyone - Rebel Inc: Escalation is coming this Tuesday, the 15th October!

Read on for all the intel on the new features that are coming to the game as well as the launch price.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35901331/f1922098ab68d5069ef99d33f07062707a0f6ef2.png[/img]
Rebel Inc: Escalation combines the original critically acclaimed gameplay of Rebel Inc. with significant, all-new features:
[list]
[*]Gorgeous Graphics - Stabilise a beautifully rendered 3D world that responds to your actions and thrives as you provide jobs and services. Drone cams and civilian TV channels bring your operation to life and show you what's happening on the ground.
[*]Clear Intelligence - Plan priorities with Intelligence Reports and Combat SITREPs, geek out with loads of new stats and graphs, and analyse your best strategies with end-of-game replays.
[*]Campaign Mode* - Conduct large scale operations across multiple regions. Carefully manage your resources, adapt to unique conditions and upgrade your team and abilities as you seek to counter the growing Insurgent threat.
[*]Co-Op and VS Multiplayer* - team up to efficiently stabilise the region with friends or compete with them in the shadows to promote your own cause.
[*]Custom Scenario Creator* - Who said Nation Building was hard! Develop your own custom scenarios with unique strategic challenges and narratives then share them with Steam Workshop.
[*]And much more* - Including daily challenges, speed runs and Mega-Brutal difficulty. Plus loads of new maps, governors and scenarios in future (free!) updates
[/list]
*Coming later in Early Access

Rebel Inc: Escalation will cost $14.99 initially. The price includes:
[list]
[*]Every paid expansion that Rebel Inc. has received to date (and all future ones)*
[*]Loads of new content updates that we have planned for the future.
[*]Significant, all-new features for PC and Mac (as listed above - Vs and Co-op Multiplayer, Scenario Creator etc.)
[/list]

The price will increase during Early Access as the additional content is released. I've thought long and hard about the price point of the game and I believe that this is a fair price which reflects the value of the additional features in Rebel Inc: Escalation without being significantly more expensive than Rebel Inc. on mobile. I hope you agree - either way, please share your opinion with me :)
